incident-bot: P0: runtime-prod kv-cache correctness regression. Symptoms: interleaved tokens, stale attention keys returned across distinct requests. Paging @lina @raj for on-call triage.
lina: joining. What triggered the alert?
incident-bot: Alert window 4m. /v1/chat error count x7. Two customer reports: ChatFlow and Marketlytics. Sampled transcripts show fragments from previous requests appearing in new responses (~6% of sampled requests).
raj: I pulled the recent deploys: batch-coalesce refactor rolled 48h ago and continuous-batcher pooling change 6h ago. My quick suspicion: slot recycling path in the KV allocator now reassigns slots without validating per-request seq tags.
dorian: logs show repeated WARN and occasionally ERROR lines: `WARN kv_cache: seq_tag_mismatch slot=slot42 expected_seq=3021 saw_seq=3050 trace=tx7b`. Also some traces show request_ids r-900 and r-905 returning identical kv pages.
mike: customers are seeing hallucinations that reference earlier session content. Support flagged severity. We need fast mitigation; avoiding full rollback would be preferred.
lina: mitigation options: 1) disable kv slot reuse (config kv.slot_reuse=false) 2) set coalesce.window=0 to force minimal batching and avoid reuse race windows 3) deploy a defensive seq-tag check on lookup that falls back to recompute. Which is fastest?
raj: quickest: flip kv.slot_reuse=false cluster-wide via adminctl, then throttle rolling restarts. That stops reuse immediately. Defensive lookup guard requires a code change albeit small.
ops-bot: runbook step issued to @raj:
```bash
adminctl set --key=kv.slot_reuse --value=false --env=prod --scope=runtime
adminctl set --key=batch.coalesce.window --value=0 --env=prod --scope=runtime
adminctl restart --service=runtime --pool=hotpool --concurrency=6
```
raj: applying to hotpool (12 hosts) now. will run canary traffic afterwards.
deploy-bot: 2026-04-10T11:05:12Z: Applied kv.slot_reuse=false to hotpool (12 hosts).
dorian: canary (6k requests) through hotpool: seq_tag_mismatch logs dropped to zero on that pool; stale-token artifacts ~0.1%. Latency p50 increased by ~30ms.
lina: great. Start rolling to other pools with small batches and 45s gaps. Notify support & CSM.
mike: CSM notified ChatFlow and Marketlytics with initial update. Both acknowledged degraded outputs; no data exfiltration.
raj: while rolling, I started streaming kv diagnostics. Observed frequent slot ID collisions when seq windows move rapidly; slot IDs are recycled using a global free-list without atomically bumping a slot revision tag. That allowed an old slot with stale seq_tag to be returned.
dorian: sample trace: `trace=tx-3f4; timeline: r-900 alloc S42 seq=3010 release; r-905 later took S42 without tag refresh; returned S42 contents.`
lina: propose short/med-term plan: short-term = config flip (done) + enable runtime fallback that checks seq_tag on lookup and treats mismatch as miss (no stale return). Medium-term = slot revision counter + checksum on slot header to allow safe reuse.
raj: I can push a small change: on cache_lookup, if slot.seq_tag != req.seq then mark miss and increment metric `kv.reuse_mismatch_count`. Will include a fast-path metric and low-overhead check. Plan to PR and canary to staging tonight.
ops-bot: rollout to pool-1/2/3 complete at 11:27. Global error-rate returning to baseline; incident severity to P1.
deploy-bot: 2026-04-10T11:27:58Z: Global flag applied: kv.slot_reuse=false across prod.
dorian: launching a fuzz-run to stress batch-coalesce + seq jitter for 45m. Starting 11:35.
lina: handing on-call to @sam at 11:45 UTC. Summary: mitigation applied (slot_reuse disabled), canary checks green, customers notified. Follow-ups: PR for lookup guard, perf/cost analysis for disabled reuse, long-term redesign.
sam: oncall ack. I'll own the postmortem and customer follow-ups.
raj: action items: PR for seq-guard (owner: raj) – will include unit tests and a lightweight integration that simulates slot churn.
lina: ALICE is out; mike please run perf delta and cost estimate for disabled reuse (owner: mike). Need tokens/sec and egress cost delta.
mike: starting perf runs now. Initial numbers: tokens/sec down ~26% under similar load, GPU utilization higher. I'll produce a short report within 3 hours.
dorian: fuzz-run status at 11:55: 10k synthetic sessions, zero stale returns so far. Will continue.
incident-bot: timeline: 11:01 alert; 11:05 hotpool mitigation; 11:15 canary green; 11:27 global flag; 11:35 fuzz job started; 11:45 on-call handoff. Incident ID: INC-2026-0410-21. Severity downgraded to P1.
sam: I'll coordinate postmortem draft and schedule a follow-up review with eng-runtime and product. Also looping in support docs for impacted customers.
lina: do we want an automated alert for `kv.reuse_mismatch_count > 5` over 1m? Could page SRE.
raj: yes, I'll add metric emission and an alert rule in the PR so it gates to paging.
mike: note: if reuse stays off long-term we need to consider hybrid: per-model slot pools or adding a cheap checksum and slot revision field to avoid correctness cost.
dorian: adding to long-term backlog: per-request partitioning (sharding slots by request-id hash) and slot-revision tagging + checksum.
incident-bot: Customer tickets linked: CHATFLOW-221, MKTLYT-79. Please add notes to incident doc.
sam: thanks team. If mismatch counts reappear after reuse re-enable, escalate immediately.
incident-bot: thread archived to incidents index after postmortem link is attached.
_meta: per agents.md: single continuous string, messages prefixed by sender names; no title field included
